# ClipForge — 100% On-Device Video, Audio & Photo Studio
> ClipForge is a bright, privacy-first browser media studio that runs video, audio, and photo tools locally inside the browser using FFmpeg WebAssembly, Web Audio API, HTML5 Canvas, and on-device ONNX AI models. No file uploads, no mandatory sign-up.

## Tools Available
- AI Background Remover (`/tools/background-remover`): On-device neural background removal with transparent PNG & solid backdrop export.
- Compress Video to Size (`/tools/compress-video`): Target exact MB limits (8MB Discord, 16MB WhatsApp, 25MB Email, Custom MB) locally via FFmpeg.wasm.
- Video Trimmer (`/tools/trim-video`): Instant lossless stream-copy or frame-accurate H.264 video cutting.
- MP4 to GIF (`/tools/mp4-to-gif`): Two-pass custom color palette GIF conversion with custom FPS and width.
- Extract / Mute Audio (`/tools/extract-audio`): Extract MP3/WAV from video or losslessly strip audio track.
- Audio Cutter & Volume Booster (`/tools/audio-cutter`): Live waveform scrubber, smooth fade-in/out, volume boost up to 300%.
- Audio to Waveform Video (`/tools/audio-to-video`): Animated audiogram generator for Reels (9:16), Square (1:1), and Landscape (16:9).
- Image Studio & Exact KB Compressor (`/tools/image-studio`): Batch JPG/PNG/WebP conversion, EXIF removal, exact KB binary-search compression, ZIP download.
- Passport & ID Photo Maker (`/tools/passport-photo`): Official India, US, UK/EU & Canada 300 DPI sizing with face alignment guide and 4x6 printable sheet.

## Pricing
- Free Tier: Free on-device processing with zero cloud uploads.
- ClipForge Pro Annual Plan: $29/year (billed annually, cancel anytime) — unlocks unlimited batch ZIPs, 4K exports, watermark-free waveform videos, and 300 DPI 4x6 printable passport sheets.
